statement: A guarded WiiRemoteRevision Plus with Nintendo TR 0330 identity, builtin-MP existence and reused external MP registers is a source-backed proposed compatibility prototype for kernel, SDL, Dolphin and Cemu enumeration, but not a verified hardware-faithful Plus and not coverage for early 0306 Plus. A Plus VID/PID without live builtin MP is particularly misleading because the kernel's Gen 2 policy expects MP; deferring model changes until physical captures has stronger fidelity discipline but no immediate Plus support. Recommendations and lab arms are not tested outcomes.

applicability.revision: Original RVL-003, early integrated RVL-036 non-TR, later RVL-036 TR; no physical revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Linux Gen 2 flags and mapping 570-605,811-927; SDL Wii detection 182-191; Dolphin accepted IDs 1033-1037; Cemu native HID 5-48; wiiuse README 103-112. Implementation tradeoff inference only. All proposed physical or host tests are not run.
